method: Hand-decompose disclosed subconfigurations into resources, targets and state meanings; run the same bounded search on old unary interfaces and on those interfaces plus registered multiport models. Blind component identifiers and names; no title query or expected path supplied to search. Conditions and calibrated finite dynamics remain separate checks.

cases.scope: Stress-induced optical modulation and intensity readout only; excludes load transfer, calibration inversion, MCU and wireless power.

cases.scope: Selected condensable vapor-to-solid capture; excludes cryosorption of hydrogen, complete shielding geometry and cooler performance.

cases.locator: Description: repeated donor/acceptor transfer, separated charges and carrier recombination after irradiation stops
cases.scope: Stored-charge emission abstraction; not triplet phosphorescence, a calibrated decay law or polymer design validation.

cases.locator: Figs. 1A–1D: normal/transition/Meissner regimes and partial field expulsion
cases.scope: Temperature/field/current-qualified material phase to local magnetic response; excludes radiation absorption, integrated pickup flux, SQUID readout and energy resolution.

cases.locator: Description: ionizing/ground electrode pair plus third static particle-detachment electrode
cases.scope: Corona-generated flow plus charged-particle force and coupled release; charge distribution, adhesion and geometry are declared. Not a traveling-wave EDS.

cases.scope: Beam-to-gas charge generation and downstream flow; excludes vacuum source/window manufacture and thrust/efficiency.

cases.scope: Existing surface photoelectric clause plus gas charging, momentum transfer and flow; beam and corona source models cannot consume the light resource.
